Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier — great to hear about Aurora's priorities on latency and auditability for clinical inference. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to get the demo + tech deep dive scheduled across your global team: 

Key takeaways (short):
- Primary success criteria: sub-100ms median latency for inference on 512-token prompts; predictable per-patient cost estimates.
- Security: SOC2 + VPC peering required for PHI test data; audit log granularity is important.
- Stakeholders: Liam (Director, Data Platforms), Priya (Head of Integrations), plus one backend engineer and one security lead for the deep dive.

Scheduling ask: to make participation equitable across US / EU / APAC, we typically run a 3-week rotating demo cadence so the same panel of Redwood engineers runs at times that are friendly to each region on rotation. Attached is a simple slot grid with three suggested recurring choices and timezone conversions. Please pick the option that best matches your core attendees — once you confirm, we will publish a rotating calendar series that alternates weekly. 

Suggested rotation options (all weekly repeats, we will rotate which region gets the prime slot):
A) US morning / EU afternoon / APAC overnight (example: Tue 10:00 PT / Tue 19:00 CEST / Wed 02:00 AEST)
B) EU morning / US late evening / APAC afternoon (example: Wed 09:00 CEST / Wed 01:00 PT / Wed 16:00 AEST)
C) APAC morning / US midday / EU late evening (example: Thu 09:00 AEST / Wed 12:00 PT / Thu 21:00 CEST)

Action items for you:
1) Confirm preferred option (A, B or C) or propose an alternative preferred window.
2) List the names + roles who will join the deep dive (we want to include the backend/infra + security contacts in the invite).
3) Any hard blackout dates the next two weeks?

Attachments: rotating-demo-slot-grid.csv (quick matrix), demo-briefing.pdf (one-pager we will share with your engineers).

If it helps, here is a Calendly link that surfaces our three template slots and will automatically create the rotating series after we confirm: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-1?month=2026-06

Thanks — I can do a follow-up call later this week if you prefer to walk through the options.

—Camila
